functions.notes: Size and control flow match (0x3c8). Remaining 83 bytes: (1) vector-building block after SelectCoordsByFlag0x24: target loads the data_02114e54 pool address first, then loads px and data.x together, shifts both, stores data.x back to px, and only then loads py. Mine hoists both stack loads first. Tried: separate vs aggregate init, interleaved x/y order, pointer to cursor, array and struct for px/py, all give the same or worse. (2) callee-saved allocation: target f3b0=r6, res=r7, ctx=r5, mode=r8, plus sl as a temp in that block; mine f3b0=r5, res=r6, ctx=r7 and no sl (push r3 instead of sl). The sl use probably follows from fixing (1). colorsweep --apply only produced worse results (iroalign:data_020e780c, 117 bytes), not kept.
